faq.question: What is the difference between BIM 360 and Autodesk Construction Cloud?
faq.answer: BIM 360 is Autodesk's legacy data management platform, whereas Autodesk Construction Cloud is the modern solution. It includes advanced modules like Build, BIM Collaborate, and Quantity Takeoff.

faq.question: What is the difference between Autodesk Docs and BIM Collaborate?
faq.answer: Autodesk Docs serves as a document management platform for BIM and CAD files. BIM Collaborate, on the other hand, extends capabilities with cloud-based workflows such as clash detection and model reviews.

faq.question: How much does BIM Collaborate cost?
faq.answer: BIM Collaborate is priced at $945 per year, making it a cost-effective choice compared to BIM Collaborate Pro at $1,284 per year. Customers of our BIM service packages receive complimentary access to BIM Collaborate Pro.

faq.question: How do I start outsourcing my BIM services?
faq.answer: To get started, please share all existing BIM and CAD files related to your project.
